purpose: Development-only cost-opportunity audit; not a learned-method comparison or benchmark score
step_limit_reason: Unmodified full-OS run_pi05_libero_real_e2e.py default; do not shorten execution to manufacture failures. Previous engineering pilot used 220 and is not a matched cost comparator.
path: Full OS original verifier and experience feedback; common strict JSON parser; sequential shared development experience; all tasks retained
resources: 187 HCU0 policy and HCU1 Qwen; existing fixed weights and images; resident services for entire stream; CPU limits unchanged
laya: Shadow legality only, no control, no training; no model call when only escalation is available
selection: Full spatial suite in ascending task order, one previously unused development initialization per task; descriptions read from frozen suite metadata before episodes
evaluation: No final-test evaluation; all these instances are permanently designated development. Future held-out initializations must exclude 0 through 8 on task0 and initialization8 on all screened tasks.
stop: Stop on infrastructure failure, missing evidence, resource conflict or time limit; retain ordinary task failures and all attempted cases. Do not extend roster based on observed outcomes.
decision_scope: Audit repeated analysis, evidence preparation, candidate validation and recovery; do not presume recovery is the winning intervention. Native success/reward and hidden state are evaluator-only for any new router.
